SIGILL trap: zig zcc/zcxx default to -mcpu=native, detects Neoverse V2 (MIDR 0xd4f) and emits SVE/SVE2, but this VM hides SVE (/proc/cpuinfo has no sve). Every lqt test died with ILLEGAL (19/21). DEFAULT_BACKEND is now 'native' (cognition/lqt_bridge.py; $LQT_BACKEND=python still selects originals; native import failure raises LQTBackendUnavailable, no fallback). NativeBackend: .contract(a,b,axes) via lqt_native RecursiveTensor (tensordot semantics, int or (ax_a,ax_b)) -> f32 ndarray; .new_recursive_tensor(...)->NativeTensor(.data writable f32; uniform draws np.random U(-0.01,0.01) like the original); .create_storage()->NativeModelStore. LQTStore(backend): same put/get/save/load/summary/buckets API; native adds .native (NativeModelStore: .model LqtModel, .edit_log(), .verify_edit_log(), .rollback_updates(n)), LQTStore.rollback(n) (undo last n puts), LQTStore.verify_edit_log(). Native layout per weight: Codebook(2**bits, FP16-exact) + RecursiveTensor descriptor rank5 [r,c,1,1,1] + RtaBlock Uniform + FP32 DeltaBuffer eps; put() on an existing name = edit_codebook_scalar (changed centroids, B kept) + update_delta, all hash-chain logged. save(dir) -> dir/psi_weights.lqt (+manifest.json) with one RecursiveWeight bucket per lattice position, re-loaded and checked bit-exact + verify_edit_log before returning. summary() gains '_edit_log' key on native.

Operator ruling needed: D-024 makes an attached RecursiveWeight bucket authoritative for its position (overrides delta), and LqtModel has no logged mutation op for a RecursiveWeight. So live Psi weights cannot carry RW buckets AND take update_delta edits. Resolution taken: live model = B indices + codebook + eps delta (editable, logged); RW buckets attached only in the checkpoint .lqt image (bit-identical reconstruct); load() rebuilds the live model from the buckets (cross-checked vs index array + delta) and records resumed_from {sha256, edit_log tail hash} since the edit log restarts. Smallest unblocker: a logged MutationType for RecursiveWeight edits in lqt/ (lqt-bindings lane).

  bind_unified(um) BEFORE constructing RSILoop/TriaxialField: the backbone's Psi store (NativeModelStore) becomes a bucket view of um (W_R/W_E/W_M = RW buckets; put() = one RecursiveWeightEdit). Without a bound model, NativeModelStore owns a fresh UnifiedModel and store.save(dir) writes dir/model.lqt + manifest.json {format:'lqt-unified'}. psi_weights.lqt / old manifests are refused (no fallback).
  collect_live_tensors(engine, iala, bayes, motivation) -> {path: LiveTensor(.get/.set/.group)} : every float tensor of the stack by stable BFS path (torch params/buffers, RW registry, triaxial field RTA/ethical/metacog, IALA, Bayes beliefs, motivation entities); excludes activations/histories/caches and Psi.
Layout: codebook 0 = RW base (256 FP16-exact entries, uniform [-1,1]); every tensor = RecursiveTensor desc (own shape padded to rank 5, UINT8, codebook 0, scale=max|w|), Uniform RtaBlock (metadata shape/group/repr), and either one scalar RW bucket per position (<=4096 elems, or created during a run) or the D-024 structural term B+FP32 eps delta (>4096 elems at genesis). Live always takes model.reconstruct.
CLI: python -m runtime.train --steps N --seed S --out DIR  (native = unified: genesis if DIR/model.lqt absent, then load->run->sync each step->save same file->reload check->rollback check) ; python -m runtime.train --verify-model DIR/model.lqt (fresh process, vs DIR/live_sha256.json).
